concepts.name: Pearl ledger
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished portrait mobile Settings screenshot for Socially, a Solana investing app with Captain fund managers and Crew investors. Reference images show the existing visual family; they are style references, not layouts to copy. Fit the complete Settings landing page into a normal phone viewport, approximately 393x852 aspect ratio, with no device frame, no collage, no numbered caption inside the UI. Prioritize minimal scrolling through compact organization and detail destinations; readable text and comfortable mobile touch targets, no tiny crowded labels. Palette: #F5F7FB pale canvas, #F9FBFD pearl, #E4F3FD ice-blue, #182B43 navy, #64758B muted text, #D8F9EE mint accents. Cormorant Garamond editorial headings, Inter utility text, white rims, fine blue borders, restrained shadows, simple consistent outline icons. Identity: captain-emblem avatar, "Vikas Kumar", "@vikaskumar"; no verified badge. Existing Settings destinations: Edit profile, Account (profile/sign-in), Display (balance visibility, fixed light theme, English/USD), Invite a friend, Help & support, About Socially, Terms, Privacy, Log out. Keep destinations directly reachable or behind clearly named groups. Do not invent notifications, biometric authentication, connected wallets, rewards or financial statistics. Developer controls stay out of the production landing page. Bottom navigation MUST match references: separate pearl Home capsule on the left and pearl three-icon capsule on the right containing compass, wallet and gear; selected gear in navy circle, other icons blue-gray. Content must clear the nav; preserve its visual proportions. High-fidelity implementable app design, crisp exact English text.
Concept direction: A compact editorial 'Settings' heading and quiet logout icon. A short horizontal frosted identity card: avatar beside name and handle, small Edit button. One cohesive pearl panel of FOUR compact destination rows: Account, Display, Invite a friend, Help & support, with small pale-blue icon wells, fine inset separators and chevrons. No long subtitles. About Socially, Terms, Privacy and v1.0.0 in a quiet footer above navigation. Calm, direct and spacious; all essential content visible.
